# Mediterranean Rescue, full version

> Rescue operations at sea in the central Mediterranean, documented with their source. Site: https://rescue.memolabs.dev . Code: https://github.com/memolabs-dev/mediterranean-rescue (MIT). An independent volunteer project, started from the public Data for Good repository dataforgoodfr/mediterranean-rescue. It is not the official website of SOS MEDITERRANEE; the association's reference map is https://map.sosmediterranee.org.

## Why it exists

SOS MEDITERRANEE's public map reads a Google Sheet whose last operation dates from February 2024. Since then, the crew has kept describing each rotation in the public logbook of sosmediterranee.org, as free text. This project reads both records, turns the logbook sentences into rows in the spreadsheet's own columns, and asks a volunteer to check each row against its sentence before anything is published. Totals rebuilt this way match the association's 2024 and 2025 annual reports.

## Public site

- `/`: map, feed and month-by-month view of the published operations, each with its source and evidence. English and French (language switch in the header).
- `/about`: where each figure comes from, how far the spreadsheet lags, what was rebuilt and what is verified.

## Public API (read only, no key)

- `GET /api/v1/events/`: published operations (kind, date, people, women, minors, position, port, vessel, voyage, source URL), paginated, with `total_count`.
- `GET /api/v1/events/{id}/` and `/api/v1/events/{id}/evidence/`: one operation and the evidence it rests on.
- `GET /api/v1/map-points/`, `GET /api/v1/timeline/`.
- `GET /api/v1/schema/`: the OpenAPI contract (also in contracts/openapi.yaml).

## Team space (`/workspace`, sign-in required, not indexed)

A workstation for invited volunteers. Every decision is recorded with its author, date and reason.
- Review: verify each logbook operation against the sentence it was read from.
- Imports and ports: staged rows from the spreadsheet tabs, port names matched once.
- Publish: two steps take a verified operation to this project's public site, each with a reason.
- Data: export the checked rows in the spreadsheet's own columns, for the person who keeps the spreadsheet.
- History, team, help, and a practice mode on invented operations.
Volunteers join through a single-use invitation link (`/invite`).

## Data rules

- Unknown stays empty, never zero. No identity, position or count is invented.
- Counts are per event, not unique people, and are not independently confirmed.
- Readers stage rows privately: the spreadsheet every five minutes, the logbook every six hours. Nothing is linked, drafted or published automatically.
- Publication needs a person with the publish role, a reason, and a recorded source agreement. Real exports never enter the repository; tests use fictitious data.

## Stack

Django 5.2 LTS, Django REST Framework, drf-spectacular, PostgreSQL 17 with PostGIS. React 19 with the React Compiler, Base UI, MapLibre, TanStack Query. One production image serves the API and the built frontend; every green commit on main is deployed.
